title: Classic British Eggs Benedict Scramble
description: A British twist on the classic eggs benedict, with a fluffy scrambled egg filling and a side of buttery muffins.

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.notes: Light, fluffy eggs are essential for this dish

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.notes: Whole milk adds richness and creaminess

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.notes: Unsalted butter for toasting muffins and adding flavor

ingredients.name: english muffins
ingredients.notes: Split and toasted for a crunchy base

ingredients.name: ham
ingredients.notes: Optional, but adds a salty, meaty flavor

ingredients.name: cheddar cheese
ingredients.notes: Shredded cheddar for an extra burst of flavor

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: Add a pinch of salt to bring out the flavors

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.notes: Freshly ground black pepper for added depth

instructions: Toast the English muffins until lightly browned.
In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add the diced ham (if using) and cook until lightly browned.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and milk.
Pour the egg mixture over the ham and cook until the eggs are almost set.
Use a spatula to gently scramble the eggs, breaking them up into small curds.
Season the eggs with salt and black pepper to taste.
Split the toasted English muffins in half and top each half with a spoonful of scrambled eggs.
Place a slice of cheddar cheese on top of the eggs and place under the broiler until melted and bubbly.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
